current_desktop_acceptance.scope: Four physical desktops, six unordered pairs and twelve media directions. Android excluded only from this acceptance round; long-term Android support and historical records retained.
current_desktop_acceptance.legacy_inventory_and_directions: Historical supplied observations; do not treat top-level 2026-10-09 inventory or prior direction outcomes as fresh acceptance.

target.rule: Before any pass, bind both actual running images to this exact source snapshot and reviewed platform configuration, artifact/build identity and final observed release receipt. A future target change must invalidate prior target-specific passes explicitly. Matrix documentation commit alone does not change installed product provenance.
target.documentation_revision_policy: feba70a is the frozen binary acceptance baseline, not the moving documentation HEAD. Later acceptance-plan/matrix documentation commits do not by themselves constitute a binary version difference or invalidate unchanged candidate bytes. Verify each runtime against its original compiler source snapshot, build identity, configuration, artifact hash and observed receipt; never relabel an artifact with the documentation commit or waive a producer source-snapshot check.

current_desktop_acceptance.direction_semantics: A -> B means A captures/publishes, B receives/presents. active_push is initiated in A; active_pull is initiated in B against A. Input evidence is B -> the bound A fixture. The reverse row is independently executed.

pass_requirements.active_push: Actual installed A UI initiates push to B; B confirms/rendered source and peer identity. Receive-only CLI does not prove active push.
pass_requirements.active_pull: Actual installed B selects/pulls A source; authenticated source/revision and visible result recorded.
pass_requirements.video: Actual capture/encode/transport/native decode and visibly changing presented owned fixture, exact source/PID/revision, frame/error/timing evidence. UI submission alone is insufficient.
pass_requirements.audio: Known fixture signal captured and received with playback/output evidence; audible or independently measured output, mute/unmute and correct session ownership. Callbacks alone remain partial.
pass_requirements.mouse_click: Through product control chain only, one click in the bound owned target window with native event and visible state change; adjacent window unchanged.
pass_requirements.keyboard_input: Through product control chain only, short non-sensitive fixture text, actual native/visible result and paired down/up; release on focus/lease/source change.
pass_requirements.disconnect_reconnect: Disconnect only this test session through product UI, re-establish authenticated route and source revision, restore visible/audio/control behavior, reject stale input, prove native resource cleanup. Do not sever shared network or other sessions.

pairing.detail: Latest 2026-10-17 Mac status reports zero routes/sessions on both Macs. Earlier same-day group digests differ on MacBook/Studio/HO5. Do not read/forward invitation secrets or recreate groups. Await ordinary owner UI pairing; then recheck non-sensitive routes.

Synthetic fixtures alone, unit tests, builds, source lists and historical versions cannot satisfy a current physical-device pass. Unknown/unsupported are never converted to passed.
